reviewer: Independent model critic; same project agent team, not a human/user panel
method: Isolated Chromium; screenshots before builder rationale. Unblinded product names/paths, no builder provenance/rationale read. Twelve new entry screens at 390x844 and 1440x900; seven bounded local actions; six older representative entries at 1440x900. Reduced motion enabled. Screenshot artifacts are local ignored outputs.
comparisonLimits: Different briefs and budgets, not randomized blinded A/B or frozen benchmark results. Browser UI studies only; no native lifecycle, device semantics, controller or gameplay verification. First-frame screenshots do not establish every state.

records.judgment: Print artifact and serif hierarchy give a specific editorial identity.
records.fault: At390, essential headline 'impression.' is visibly clipped right with horizontal scrollbar; measured root overflow43px.
records.action: Allow safe headline wrapping or a smaller phone display scale; constrain tilted specimen overflow without hiding essential words.

recheck.observation: Fresh390 capture shows Words with weight. fully readable, print sheet contained and no root overflow (scrollWidth375 at innerWidth390). Initial fault preserved above.

records.judgment: Fluorescent field, emphatic headline and material inventory compose differently from botanical/letterpress; original illustrations support subject.
records.fault: No blocking first-frame fault observed; lower card details and filter behavior not independently exercised.
records.action: Review filtered empty state and card content at long labels before promotion.

records.judgment: Plant drawing, dark ground and restrained serif carry the seed subject; phone composition remains legible.
records.fault: Phone first fold separates plan controls from the introductory action through substantial illustration space; no task-success conclusion.
records.action: Check anchor arrival/focus at growing-plan controls and contextual heading with keyboard/touch.

records.judgment: Condensed poster typography and bicycle silhouette form a distinct event identity.
records.fault: Overlapping display wordforms are intentionally dense; support copy is necessary for quick reading. No essential root clipping observed.
records.action: Review full event date/location and reading order before using similar overlap elsewhere.

records.judgment: Map, editorial proposition and bounded booking form give a clear local selection flow.
records.fault: Primary form begins below introductory map on390; no small-screen full task or keyboard study performed.
records.action: Verify review action remains discoverable with keyboard/large text; preserve selected inputs during failure.

records.judgment: Technical part illustration and stock rows support workshop context.
records.fault: On390, large branding block and all stock cards precede checkout; selected-part action is distant from first choice.
records.action: Compact branding on task screens; consider persistent selected-part/quantity summary after selection.

recheck.observation: Brand block compacted. Choosing first part focuses qty and scrolls checkout/selection into view; visible focused input and Record use action captured. Native keyboard behavior unverified.

records.judgment: Newspaper-style dispatch hierarchy contrasts with generic metric-card dashboard.
records.fault: 390 header consumes about350px and selected decision detail follows both exception cards; urgent action becomes distant.
records.action: Compact phone masthead/proposition; bring selected detail and decision next to selection or scroll focus deliberately.

recheck.observation: Heading and exception summaries are more compact; selected decision visible in first390 fold. Form begins below fold; no critical failure demonstrated and deliberate scrolling remains acceptable.

records.judgment: Instrument-like plot and supporting numeric facts fit synthetic spectral work.
records.fault: 390 SVG chart labels shrink to visually unreadable tiny glyphs while chart surface reserves large blank vertical areas.
records.action: Recompose mobile chart with native-sized axes/labels and appropriate height, or offer accessible tabular values.

recheck.observation: Axes now readable at390. Plot uses horizontal scrolling with visible scrollbar; full trace no longer simultaneously visible. Keyboard/screen-reader chart navigation remains unverified.

records.judgment: Pink cover geometry and music hierarchy differ materially from transit and field-note studies.
records.fault: Artwork dominates phone fold; player controls meet bottom navigation near fold. No native safe-area/large-text proof.
records.action: Verify lower controls under short heights/keyboard and retain explicit unavailable-audio feedback.

recheck.observation: At320x568 last track was programmatically focused, browser scrolled it into view with visible outline and no bottom-control obstruction. Not a complete sequential-keyboard or native safe-area test.

records.judgment: Route alternatives, travel-time emphasis and step timeline are task-specific.
records.fault: Start sample journey lies at/below390 fold after route steps, so selection requires scroll; no first-task test.
records.action: Assess sticky summary/action after route choice without obscuring steps; test large text.

records.judgment: Timeline tracks, transport and recordings compose as a desktop workspace rather than marketing hero.
records.fault: Phone compresses waveform/time context and uses a horizontally scrolling recording strip; no precision-edit claim justified.
records.action: State narrow-window supported task limits and validate tab strip keyboard discoverability; native desktop input still unverified.

records.judgment: Spatial route briefing with resource choices is clearly different from original river HUD.
records.fault: Phone spatial view precedes choice controls by substantial scrolling; static map does not establish a usable gameplay HUD.
records.action: Keep planning-study label, test controller focus separately and verify resource review on small windows.

facts: Botanical build-plan action displayed a local plant plan.
Kinetic review without lights confirmation produced a validation message.
Inventory record without chosen part produced a validation message.
Editorial card activation changed selected decision record; missing address blocked assignment wording.
Music play reported no audio files, not successful playback.
Tactical review reported selected approach, fuel arithmetic and no launched mission.
Booking review reported unavailable service, preserved selection and no reservation.
localActions.limits: One selected action per listed page, not complete task coverage or automated accessibility audit.

olderSpecimens.observation: Older examples share pale fields, small utility labels and repeated panels; newer showcases show substantially more varied subject/typographic/material composition. New compactness/readability regressions remain. This is subjective model critique, not a superiority result.

outcome: Useful differentiated craft candidates, with phone clipping/chart-label faults to fix and task-density refinements before reviewed promotion. No independent-human or controlled-comparison claim.

recheck.method: Fresh isolated Chromium screenshots viewed at390x844; music320x568. Inventory first-part selection exercised.
recheck.limits: Chart now horizontally scrolls. Dispatch form still below fold. Full keyboard/native/runtime claims remain unverified.
